metaTitle: AIS Alumni — the Aichi International School community

hero.title: Stay connected with the AIS community
hero.lead: One place for former students, parents, teachers and staff to find each other, join reunions and hear news from the AIS Alumni Committee.

directory.title: Find classmates and teachers
directory.body: Search by graduation year, division or what people are doing now. Contact details are shared only with people you accept.

events.title: Reunions and events
events.body: RSVP in one tap and get email reminders a week and a day before.

news.title: News from the committee
news.body: Announcements for alumni, parents and staff, in Japanese and English.

line.title: Updates on LINE
line.body: Link LINE to get chat mentions and important notices from the AIS Alumni Committee official account. Email works too.

privacy.title: Verified members only
privacy.body: Every account is checked by the committee before it can see other members.

family.title: Families together
family.body: Parents and children can link their accounts, and students' privacy is protected.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.body: Use your email, Google or LINE. It takes a minute.

verify.title: Tell us your AIS connection
verify.body: Your years at AIS, your role and a classmate or teacher who knows you.

approved.title: Get approved
approved.body: The committee reviews your application and lets you know by email.

audience.title: Who can join
audience.body: Teachers and staff, current students and parents, former students, and parents of former students.

cta.title: Ready to reconnect?
cta.body: Create your account and apply for membership today.

about.title: Who runs this
about.body: This app is run independently by the AIS Alumni Committee, a volunteer group of AIS graduates. It is not operated or managed by Aichi International School.
